scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/shared && npm test -w packages/ai && npm test -w apps/server && npm test -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/ai && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
